source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-29

procedures.title: Brake disc: check runout, remove and install
steps: Turn the disc; the indicator must not read over .002 in. If it does, replace the hub and disc assembly; front discs should not be machined or serviced separately.
Readjust the front wheel bearings afterward (see Section 3).
(Rear, Corvette only) Check rear wheel bearing end play (see Section 4), then dial-indicate the disc face. Replace the disc if its lateral runout is more than .004 in. beyond the bearing end play.
(Removal) Put the car on a hoist and remove the wheel and tire.
Remove the caliper.
Drill out the 5 rivets holding the disc to the hub or spindle.
Take off the disc.
Finish removing the 5 rivets from the hub or spindle.
(Installation) Fit the disc on the hub or spindle, lining up the lug bolts with the holes in the disc.
Install the caliper and shoes.
Bleed the brakes.
Refit the wheel and tire and lower the car.

specs.what: rear disc lateral runout over bearing end play, maximum (Corvette)

notes: Once the rivets are out, the disc need not be re-riveted; the lug nuts hold it. But fit the lug nuts (without the wheel) when checking runout of a disc whose rivets have been removed.
CAUTION: line up the parking brake adjusting holes in the spindle and disc.
CAUTION: do not move the car until the pedal is firm.
Main cylinder service on disc-brake cars is the same as for the Duo-Servo main cylinder (p.5-17 to 5-20).

procedures.title: Parking brake shoes (Corvette): remove and install
steps: (Removal) Remove the wheel and tire and the brake disc.
Take off the retractor spring at the top of the shoes, then the hold down springs on the primary and secondary shoes.
Pull the shoes off the anchor pin.
Remove the adjusting screw spring and adjusting screw from the shoes.
(Installation) Lightly coat the pads, backing plate and adjusting screw threads with Lubriplate.
Hook the adjusting screw spring into the bottom hole of each shoe.
Fit the star wheel between the shoes: next to the rear shoe on left-hand brakes, next to the forward shoe on right-hand brakes.
Spread the shoes and fit them on the backing plate around the anchor pin.
Install the hold down springs on the hold down pins.
Hook the retractor spring on one shoe and stretch it to the other.
Refit the disc and caliper.
Bleed the brakes.
Adjust the parking brake (p.5-24).
Refit the wheels and lower the car.
notes: CAUTION: position the shoe-spreading lever so its notches sit against the shoes.
See figure 44 in the manual (exploded view: shoes, hold down springs/caps and pins, actuating lever, retractor spring, backing plate, parking plate, adjusting screw spring and assembly).
